request_text: Fix product regression (#6071 child, #7 in triage): mission close --discard refuses with BRANCH_HAS_UNIQUE_COMMITS because branch deletion routes through guarded_branch_delete (#5965 FR-009) with no discard-authorized operator_intent, so abandoning a mid-flight mission with its own unmerged commits is refused; plus _force_delete_branch_if_exists only catches RuntimeError while DestructiveOpRefused subclasses Exception. Add a discard-scoped bypass intent, thread it through the explicit-discard delete paths only, update the architectural intent-caller allowlist gate deliberately, fix the except clause, red-first tests. Product fix in a safety-critical destructive guard.
